ह Subst. 	 mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Laughter. Adj. Mad, drunk. 	 m. (-हः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 2. Water. 	 3. A cypher. 	 4. Meditation. 	 5. Auspiciousness. 	 6. Sky heaven. 	 7. Paradise. 	 8. Blood. 	 9. Dying. 	 10. Fear. 	 11. Know-ledge. 	 12. The moon. 	 13. VISHṆU. 	 14. War, battle. 	 15. Horripila tion. 	 16. A horse. 	 17. Pride. 	 18. A physician. 	 19. Cause, motive f. (-हा) 	 1. A bandoning, leaving. 	 2. Coition. 	 3. A lute. 	 n. (-हं) 	 1. GOD, the supreme soul. 	 2. Pleasure, delight. 	 3. Calling, calling to 4. A weapon. 	 5. The sparkling of a gem. 	 6. हंस: हंस m. (-सः) 	 1. A goose, a gander, a flamingo, a swan. The descrip tion of this bird as found in sanskrit poetry is rather poetical than real; swans are considered to fly to the MĀNASA-LAKE when monsoon sets in; they are also represented as being the vehicle of BRAHMĀ; there is a convention among poets that this bird is gifted with the power of separating milk from water. 	 2. BRAHMĀ the supreme soul. 	 3. VISHṆU. 	 4. The sun. 	 5. A liberal or moderate prince, one not covetous nor ambitious. 	 6. A sort of ascetic or devotee. 	 7. A particular Mantra, or mystical or magical pray-er. 	 8. A horse. 	 9. One of the vital airs. 	 10. Envy, malice. 	 11. ŚIVA. 	 12. (In composition,) Best excellent. 	 13. Preceding, before, in front. 	 14. A spiritual preceptor. 	 15. A mountain. 	 16. A buffalo. 	 17. KĀMA. 	 18. The individual soul. 	 f. (-सी) A goose.  E. हन् to hurt or kill, Unādi aff. स; also this word is curiously derived by native philologists, viz:--भवेद् वर्णागमाद् हंसः i. e. it is derived from हस् by the insertion of a nasal; also with कन् added, हंसक ।
हंसक: हंसक m. (-कः) 	 1. An ornament for the feet, described as being made like a goose's foot. 	 2. The flamingo.  E. कन् added to the last.
हंसकीलक: हंसकीलक m. (-कः) A particular form of sexual union.
हंसकूट: हंसकूट m. (-टः) The hump on the shoulder of the Indian ox.  E. हंस a goose, कूट a peak.
हंसगति: हंसगति Adj. Having a swan's gait.
हंसगद्गदा: हंसगद्गदा f. (-दा) A woman speaking sweetly or pleasantly.  E. हंस a goose, गद् to sound, reiterated, affs. अच् and टाप् ।
हंसगामिनी: हंसगामिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A woman having a graceful gait. 	 2. An epithet of Brahmāni.  E. हंस a goose, (or swan,) गामिनी who goes, (like.)
हंसतूल: हंसतूल mn. (-लः-लं) The soft feathers of a goose.
हंसदाहन: हंसदाहन n. (-नं) Agallochum.  E. हंस a goose, दाहन burning, exciting.
हंसनाद: हंसनाद m. (-दः) Cackling, the cry or noise of a goose.  E. हंस, नाद sound.
हंसनादिन्: हंसनादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Cackling, making a noise like a goose. 	 f. (-दिनी) An elegant woman, one of slender waist and large posteriors, with the gait of an elephant and voice of a Kokila. E. हंस a goose, नाद cry, इनि and ङीष् affs.
हपदी: हपदी f. (-दी) 	 1. A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.) 	 2. Another plant, perhaps Clitoria ternata.  E. हंस a goose, and पद foot; from a fancied resemblance between it and the flower; also हंसपादी ।
हंसपाद: हंसपाद n. (-दं) Vermilion. 	 f. (-दी) A shrub, (Clitoria ternata.)  E. हंस a goose, पाद a foot, (to which they are compared in colour, form, &c.:) see the last; also in the fem. form, कन् added, हंसपादिका ।
हंसमाला: हंसमाला f. (-ला) 	 1. A duck. 	 2. A flight or flock or wild geese. 	 3. A kind of metre.  E. हंत a goose, माला a garland or wreath.
हंसरथ: हंसरथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ.  E. हंस a goose, and रय vehicle.
हंसवती: हंसवती f. (-ती) A creeper, (Cissus pedata.)  E. हंस a goose, (its foot,) and मतुप् aff.
हंसवाहन: हंसवाहन m. (-नं) BRAHMĀ.  E. हंस a goose, and वाहन a vehicle.
हंसवीज: हंसवीज n. (-जं) The egg of a goose.  E. हंस, वीज seed.
हंसाङ्घ्रि: हंसाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) Vermilion.  E. हंस a goose, and अङ्घ्रि the foot.
हसाधिरूढा: हसाधिरूढा f. (-ढा) An epithet of SARASWATĪ.
हंसाभिख्य: हंसाभिख्य n. (-ख्यं) Silver.  E. हंस a goose, अभिख्या beauty; being of similar colour.
हंसिका: हंसिका f. (-का) A female goose.  E. हंसो the female goose, and कन् added; or हन् to kill, सिकन् Unādi aff.
हंहो: हंहो Ind. 	 1. An interjection of calling, (ho, hollo!) 	 2. A particle of haughtiness or arrogance. 	 3. An arrogantly interrogative particle. In drama it is found used as a form of address in speeches assigned to characters of the middling class.  E. हं and हो both vocative particles.
हक्क: हक्क m. (-क्कः) The calling of elephants.  E. हक् imitative sound, कै to utter, ड aff.
हक्कार: हक्कार m. (-रः) Calling, calling to.  E. हक् sound of calling, कार making.
हञ्जा: हञ्जा Ind. (In theatrical language,) A vocative particle used in calling to a female attendant.  E. हिडि to treat with disrespect or contempt, aff. आ, and the deriv. irr.; also with ए aff. हञ्जे ।
हञ्जि: हञ्जि m. (-ञ्जिः) 	 1. Hunger. 	 2. Sneezing.  E. हमित्यव्यक्तं जयति जि-डि ।
हञ्जे: हञ्जे Ind. (In theatrical language,) A vocative particle to be used in addressing a female attendant. E. See हञ्जा ।
हट्: हट् r. 1st cl. (हटति) To shine, to be bright.
हट्ट: हट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A market, a movable market, a fair. 	 f. (-ट्टी) A petty market or fair.  E. हट् to shine, ट aff., form irr.
हट्टचौरक: हट्टचौरक m. (-कः) A thief, one stealing at fairs and markets.  E. हट्ट a market, and चौर a theif, कन् pleonasm.
हट्टविलासिनी: हट्टविलासिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A sort of perfume. 	 2. A whore. 	 3. Turmeric.  E. हट्ट a market, विलस् to wanton or delight, णिनि and ङीप् affs.
हठ्: हठ् r. 1st cl. (हठति) 	 1. To leap or jump. 	 2. To be wicked. 	 3. To treat with violence, to oppress. 	 4. To bind to a post.
हठ: हठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. Violence. 	 2. Oppression. 	 3. Rapine. 	 mf. (-ठः-ठी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)  E. हठ् to treat with violence, aff. अच् । The instrumental and ablative singulars, “हठेन” and “हठात्” are used as indeclinables in the sense of “forcibly,” “violently,” “suddenly.”
हठ (ट) पर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria ocatandra.)  E. हठ Pistia, पर्ण a leaf.
हठयोग: हठयोग m. (-गः) A particular mode of YOGA, or abstract contemplation difficult to practise, and as such distinguished from RĀJA-YOGA, which is an easy mode of abstraction. It is performed in various ways, such as standing on one leg, holding up the arms, inhaling smoke with the head inverted, &c.
हठविद्या: हठविद्या f. (-द्या) The science of forced meditation.
हठालु: हठालु m. (-लुः) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)  E. हठ Pistia, आलु a root.
हडि: हडि m. (-डिः) A sort of stocks or wooden fetters. “हाडिकाठ” इति भाषा ।  E. हठ्-इन् ।
हडिक: हडिक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a servant of the lowest caste and meanest function.  E. हठ् to be wicked, इकक् aff.; also हड्डिक ।
हड्ड: हड्ड n. (-ड्डं) 	 1. A bone. 	 2. A sweeper: see the last.  E. हठ्-ड ।
हड्डक: हड्डक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a Mehter.  E. कन् added to the last.
हड्डज: हड्डज n. (-जं) The marrow of the bones.  E. हड्ड a bone, ज born.
हण्डा: हण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A large earthen pot. Ind. An interjection of calling to a low female: see हण्डे.
हण्डिका: हण्डिका f. (-का) A earthen pot or boiler; also हण्डी and हण्डा ।
हण्डिकासुत: हण्डिकासुत m. (-तः) A small earthen pot.  E. हण्डिका, सुत son.
हण्डे: हण्डे Ind. A vocative particle to be addressed in theatrical language to a female of inferior rank.  E. हिडि to treat with contempt or disrespect, aff. ए, and the form irr.; also with आ aff., हण्डा.

हतक: हतक m. (-कः) A coward, a poltroon. 	 f. (-का) Adj. Miserable, ill-bred, (generally used at the end of compounds.)  E. हत slain, कन् aff.
हतकण्टक: हतकण्टक Adj. 	 1. Freed from thorns, (lit.) 	 2. Freed from enemies, (fig.)
हतचित: हतचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, astounded, bereft of sense.  E. हत, चित mind.
हतजीवित: हतजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deprived of life or hope, overcome with despair. 	 n. (-तं) Despair.  E. हत, and जीवित living.
हतताप: हतताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Cool after great heat.  E. हत, and ताप heat.
हतसम्पद: हतसम्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reduced to poverty.  E. हत, and सम्पद property.
हतसाध्वस: हतसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fearless, free from fear.  E. हत, साध्वस fear.
हताश: हताश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 	 1. Cruel, merciless. 	 2. Desponding, despairing. 3. Vile, wicked. 	 4. Barren. 	 5. Weak, powerless.  E. हत destroyed, आशा hope, (in or by whom.)
हताश्व: हताश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Having the horses killed.  E. हत, अश्व a horse.
हति: हति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Striking, a stroke. 	 2. Killing. 	 3. Defect, flaw. 	 4. Multiplication, (in arithmetic.)  E. हन्, causal v., क्तिन् aff.
हतौजस्: हतौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Debilitated, weak. 	 m. (-जाः) A kind of fever, fever with debility.  E. हत, and ओजस् vigour.
हत्नु: हत्नु m. (-त्नुः) 	 1. Sickness, disease. 	 2. A weapon.  E. हन् to kill or hurt, कत्नुच् Unādi aff.
हत्या: हत्या f. (-त्या) Killing, slaying, (used chiefly in criminal killing, as in ब्रह्महत्या the murder of a Brāhman, गोहत्या killing a cow, &c.  E. हन् to kill, क्यप् aff., and न changed to त ।
हत्वा: हत्वा Ind. Having struck or killed.  E. हन् to hurt, &c., क्त्वा aff.
हत्थ: हत्थ m. (-थः) A man dejected or in low spirits.  E. हन् to hurt, क्थन् aff.
हद्: हद् r. 1st cl. (हदते) To evacuate as fæces, to discharge excrement.
हदन: हदन n. (-नं) The act of voiding excrement.

To remove, to take away. 	 4. To obstruct. 	 5. To put an end to in any manner. 	 6. To multiply, (in math.) 	 7. To go, to move, (not used in classical literature; in a few places where it is found so used poeticians have held the use to be faulty.) With अप, 1. To destroy, to ward off. 	 2. To lesson. With अव, 1. To strike, to hit. 	 2. To thresh, to winnow, (as corn.) With आ, (Atm.) 	 1. To strike at. 	 2. To beat, (as a drum.) With उद्, 1. To elevate. 	 2. To become haughty or vain. With उप, 1. To destroy. 	 2. To vex. With नि, 1. To strike. 	 2. To beat, (as a drum.) 	 3. To kill. 	 4. To frustrate, to render void. 	 5. To neglect. 	 6. To cure, (as a disease.) With परा, 1. To strike down or back. 	 2. To assail. 	 3. To drive back. With वि, 1. To strike vio-lently. 	 2. To oppose, to impede. 	 3. To reject, to deny. 	 4. To kill. With अभि, 1. To sound a musical instrument. 	 2. To strike, to beat. 	 3. To inflict injury on. With आङ्, To smite. With नि or परि, To destroy entirely. With प्र, 1. To strike. 	 2. To slay. 	 3. To beat, (as a drum.) 	 4. To place upon. With प्रति, 1. To refute or ds-troy, (an opposite argument.) 	 2. To keep off, to strike back. 	 3. To repel. 	 4. To resist. 	 5. To remove. With वि and आङ्, To obstruct, to prevent, to hinder. With सम्, 1. To slaughter. 	 2. To join or unite closely. 	 3. To collect. 	 4. To diminish, to contract. हन: हन m. (-नः) A killer, a slayer.  E. हन् to kill, अच् aff.; also with क्विप् aff., हन् m. (-हा ।)
हनन: हनन n. (-नं) 	 1. Killing, destroying. 	 2. Injuring, hurting, striking. 	 3. (In arithmetic,) Multiplication.  E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट् ।
हननीय: हननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) What may be or ought to be struck, beaten, killed.  E. हन् to kill, अनीयर् aff.
हनु: हनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः or नूः-नु) 	 1. The jaw. 	 2. The chin. 	 f. (-नुः) 	 1. A drug and perfume: see हट्टविलासिनी. 	 2. A weapon. 	 3. Sickness. 	 4. Death, dying. 5. A prostitute.  E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. उत्; also with ऊङ्, हनू ।
हनुग्रह: हनुग्रह m. (-हः) Locked jaw.  E. हनु, and ग्रह seizure.

हनुमूल: हनुमूल n. (-लं) The root of the jaw or chin.
हनुस्तम्भ: हनुस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) Locked jaw.  E. हनु, and स्तम्भ stiffness.
हनूष्: हनूष् m. (-षः) A goblin, a demon.  E. हन् to kill, ऊषन् Unādi aff.
हन्त: हन्त Ind. 	 1. An inceptive particle. 	 2. An exclamation of grief, (ah, alas !) 	 3. Of pity. 	 4. Of pleasure. 	 5. Of hurry or haste. 	 6. Of joy. 7. Of surprise.  E. हन् to kill, त aff.
हन्तकार: हन्तकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Rice or any offering to be given to a guest. 	 2. The exclamation “हन्त”.  E. हन्त, कार making.
हन्तव्य: हन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What may be, or ought to be struck, killed, &c.  E. हन्, तव्य aff.
हन्तु: हन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 	 1. Death. 	 2. A bull.  E. हन् to kill, तुन् aff.
हन्तृ: हन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 	 1. A murderer, a slayer. 	 2. A thief, a robber. 	 3. A measure of food, four times four double handfuls. 	 f. (-न्त्री) 	 1. Who or what strikes or kills. 	 2. One who destroys or removes.  E. हन् to kill, तृच् Unādi aff.
हन्तोक्ति: हन्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Tenderness, compassion.  E. हन्त alas! and उक्ति saying.
हन्न: हन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Passed as ordure.  E. हद् to void fæces, aff. क्त ।
हन्यमान: हन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being killed or struck.  E. हन् to hurt or kill, pass. v., शानच् aff.
हम्: हम् Ind. 	 1. An interjection of wrath. 	 2. An expression of courtesy or respect.  E. हा, डमु aff.
हम्भा: हम्भा f. (-म्भा) The lowing of kine.  E. हम् imitative sound, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्; also हम्बा and हम्मा ।

हम्म्: हम्म् r. 1st. cl. (हम्मति) To go, to move.
हय्: हय् r. 1st cl. (हयति) 	 1. To move. 	 2. To worship. 	 3. To sound. 	 4. To be weary.

हयगन्ध: हयगन्ध n. (-न्धं) Black salt. 	 f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)  E. हय a horse, गन्ध smell.

हयङ्कष: हयङ्कष m. (-षः) 	 1. A driver, a charioteer. 	 2. INDRA'S charioteer.  E. हय a horse, or INDRA'S horse, and कष् to hurt, aff. खच् ।

हयन: हयन n. (-नं) A covered carriage. 	 m. (-नः) A year.  E. हय् to go, ल्युट् aff.
हयपुच्छ: हयपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A horse's tail. 	 f. (-च्छी) A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.)  E. हय a horse, पुच्छ the tail.
हयप्रिय: हयप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley. 	 f. (-या) The Kharjūrī tree.  E. हय a horse, प्रिय fond of.
हयमारक: हयमारक m. (-कः) A shrub, the fragrant oleander, (Nerium odorum.) E. हय a horse, मारक killer; also with मार the same, हयमार m. (-रः ।)

हयमेध: हयमेध m. (-धः) The sacrifice of a horse: see अश्वमेध.  E. हय, and मेध sacrifice.
हयवाहन: हयवाहन m. (-नः) 	 1. The son of SŪRYA. 	 2. KUVERA.  E. हय a horse, वाहन a vehicle.

हयशाला: हयशाला f. (-ला) A stable for horses.
हयशास्त्र: हयशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The art or science of training and managing horses.
हयसङ्ग्रहण: हयसङ्ग्रहण n. (-णं) The restraining or curbing of horses.

ह्रद्रोग: ह्रद्रोग m. (-गः) The sign Aquarius of the zodiac: see हृद्रोग. The word is of Greek origin.
ह्रप्: ह्रप् r. 10th cl. (ह्नापयति-ते) To speak articulately.
ह्रस्: ह्रस् r. 1st cl. (ह्रसति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To be small or few.
ह्रसित: ह्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made little, diminished. 	 2. Sounded.  E. ह्रस् to sound, &c., क्त aff.
ह्रसिमन्: ह्रसिमन् m. (-मा) Smallness, shortness.  E. ह्रस्व short, small, इमनिच् aff., and ह्रस substituted.
ह्रसिष्ठ: ह्रसिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very short or small.  E. ह्रस्व short, aff. of the irr. superlative इष्ठन्, form irr.; also with ईयसुन् aff., ह्रसीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः ।)
ह्रस्व: ह्रस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) 	 1. Short, low in stature. 	 2. Short, as a vowel. 	 3. Small, little. 	 m. (-स्वः) A dwarf.  E. ह्रस् to be small, and वन् aff.
ह्रस्वगवेधुका: ह्रस्वगवेधुका f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. ह्रस्व short, गवेधुका coix.
ह्रस्वदर्भ: ह्रस्वदर्भ m. (-र्भः) A short kind of Kuśa grass, the white sort.  E. ह्रस्व short, दर्भ Kuśa grass.
ह्रस्वपत्रक: ह्रस्वपत्रक m. (-कः) A sort of Bassia.  E. ह्रस्व short, पत्र a leaf, कन् added.
ह्रस्वशाखाशिफ: ह्रस्वशाखाशिफ m. (-फः) A bush, a shrub.  E. ह्रस्व short, शाखा a branch, and शिफा a root.
ह्रस्वाग्नि: ह्रस्वाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The gigantic Asclepias, (A. gigantea.)
ह्रस्वाङ्ग: ह्रस्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka. 	 2. A dwarf. E. ह्रस्व short, and अङ्ग the body.
ह्राद्: ह्राद् r. 1st cl. (ह्रादते) To sound inarticulately, to roar.
ह्राद: ह्राद m. (-दः) Noise, sound.  E. ह्राद् to sound, aff. घञ् ।
ह्रादिन्: ह्रादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sounding, making a sound or noise. 	 f. (-नी) 1. Lightning. 	 2. INDRA'S thunderbolt. 	 3. A river in general. 	 4. The Olibanum tree: see ह्लादिनी.  E. ह्राद् to sound inarticulately, affs. इनि and ङीप् ।
ह्रास: ह्रास m. (-सः) 	 1. Sound, noise. 	 2. Decline, decrease, deterioration.  E. ह्रस् to sound, &c., aff. घञ् ।
ह्रिणी: ह्रिणी (ह्रिणीयते) To feel ashamed. A Kandwādī root: see हृणी, य is always added on the base in the case of this root.
ह्रिणीया: ह्रिणीया f. (-या) 	 1. Censure, abuse. 	 2. Shame.  E. हृणीङ् to be ashamed, aff. यक्, the vowel changed to रि; otherwise हृणीया; or ह्रिणीङ्-यक्.
ह्रित: ह्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Ashamed, modest, bashful. 	 2. Divided, portioned. 	 3. Taken, conveyed. 	 n. (-तं) A portion, a share.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, क्त aff., and the vowel made short; or हृ to take, aff. क्त, and रि substituted for ऋ ।
ह्रिति: ह्रिति f. (-तिः) Taking, conveying.  E. रि substituted for ऋः see हृति ।
ह्रियमाण: ह्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Being taken or seized. 	 2. Being captivated, attracted, &c.  E. हृ to take, pass. v., शानच् aff.
ह्रिवेर: ह्रिवेर n. (-रं) A perfume. E. see ह्रीवेर ।
ह्री: ह्री r. 3rd cl. (-जिह्रेति) To be modest, to blush. 	 2. To be ashamed of, (with an ablative or genitive.)
ह्री f. (-ह्रीः) Shame, bashfulness.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्विप् ।
ह्रीका: ह्रीका f. (-का) 	 1. Modesty, shame, shyness. 	 2. Fear, terror, timidity. E. ह्री to be ashamed, Unādi aff. कक्; also र changed to ल, ह्लीका ।
ह्रीकु: ह्रीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. 	 m. (-कुः) 	 1. Lac. 	 2. Tin.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, Unādi aff. उन्, कुक् augment: see ह्लीकु ।
ह्रीच्छ्: ह्रीच्छ् r. 1st cl. (ह्रीच्छति) To be modest or ashamed.
ह्रीजित: ह्रीजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, ashamed.  E. ह्री shame, and, जित overcome.
ह्रीण: ह्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Ashamed, bashful.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त, and त changed to ण; deriv. irr.
ह्रीत: ह्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful, modest.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त.
ह्रीनिरास: ह्रीनिरास m. (-सः) Shamelessness.  E. ह्री, and निरास throwing.
ह्रीमत्: ह्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Bashful, modest, ashamed.  E. ह्री, and मतुप् aff.
ह्रीयन्त्रणा: ह्रीयन्त्रणा f. (-णा) The constraint of bashfulness.
ह्रीवेर: ह्रीवेर n. (-रं) A drug and perfume, Commonly Bālā.  E. ह्री shame, and वेर saffron: see the next.
ह्रीवेल: ह्रीवेल n. (-लं) A drug and perfume: see the last.  E. ह्रीवेर as before, र changed to ल; also with कन् added, ह्रीवेलक ।
ह्रुड्: ह्रुड् (ऋ) ह्रुडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रूहते) 	 1. To collect. 	 2. To go.
ह्रेप्: ह्रेप् (ऋ) ह्रेपृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेपते) To go.
ह्रेपण: ह्रेपण n. (-ण) Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
ह्रेपयत्: ह्रेपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Putting to shame, outvieing, surpassing. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., शतृ aff.
ह्रीपित: ह्रीपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made ashamed, put to shame. 	 2. Excelled, surpassed.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., क्त aff.
ह्रेष्: ह्रेष् (ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते) 	 1. To sound inarticulately, to neigh, (as horse.) 	 2. To go, to move. 	 3. To creep.
ह्रेषा: ह्रेषा f. (-षा) Neighing as a horse.  E. ह्रेष् to neigh, affs. अ and टाप् see हेषा; also read ह्लेषा
ह्रोड्: ह्रोड् (ऋ) ह्रोडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रोडति) To go, to move.
ह्रौड्: ह्रौड् (ऋ) हौडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रौडते) To go.
ह्लग्: ह्लग् (ए) ह्णगे r. 1st cl. (ह्लगति) To cover.
ह्लप्: ह्लप् r. 10th cl. (ह्लापयति-ते) To speak, to speak articulately: also ह्रप् ।
ह्लाद्: ह्लाद् (ई) ह्लादी r. 1st cl. (ह्लादते) 	 1. To gladden, to delight. 	 2. To be glad or delighted. 	 3. To sound, especially as a musical instrument. With आ, To be delighted.
ह्लाद: ह्लाद m. (-दः) Pleasure, joy.  E. ह्लाद् to be glad, aff. अच् ।
ह्लादन: ह्लादन n. (-नं) Joy, delight.  E. ह्लाद् to be glad, and ल्युट् aff.
ह्लादित: ह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, happy.  E. ह्लाद् to be happy, क्त aff.
ह्लादिन्: ह्लादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Happy, glad. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. Lightning. 	 2. INDRA'S thunderbolt. 	 3. A river in general. 	 4. The Olibanum tree: see ह्रादिनी.  E. ह्लाद् pleasure, इनि and ङीष् affs.
ह्लीका: ह्लीका f. (-का) Shame, modesty.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, कन् Unādi aff. र changed to ल
ह्लीकु: ह्लीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. 	 m. (-कुः) 	 1. Lac. 	 2. Tin.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. कुक्, र changed to ल; otherwise read ह्रीकु ।
ह्लेषा: ह्लेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, (as a horse,) braying, (as an ass, &c.)  E. ह्लेष् for ह्रेष् to neigh, &c., affs. अ and टाप् ।
ह्वल्: ह्वल् r. 1st cl. (-ह्वलति) 	 1. To move. 	 2. To shake.
ह्वान: ह्वान n. (-नं) 	 1. The act of calling. 	 2. A cry.  E. ह्वे to call, ल्युट् aff.
ह्वृ: ह्वृ r. 1st cl. (ह्वरति) 	 1. To bend, to curve, to make crooked. 	 2. To be crooked in conduct, to deceive. 	 3. To be injured.
ह्वे: ह्वे r. 1st cl. (ह्वयति-ते) 	 1. To call. 	 2. To invoke, to call upon. 	 3. To challenge. 	 4. To name. 	 5. To ask, to beg. 	 6. To emulate, to vie with, to wish to overcome or surpass. 	 7. To struggle or contend with. With आ, To call, to invite. With सम्, To call out together. With उप, नि, वि or सम्, the verb is deponent, (उपह्वयते); also with आङ् if rivalry be signified, (आह्वयते) He challenges. THE END.
